conventions.steps: ordered observable behavior; implementation may coalesce equal visual results

flows.title: Boot and initial render
steps: Read the deterministic healthy fixture.
setTheme('dark') and render the full app: chrome, brief, capability matrix, CPU lanes, advisor mini, threads, event mix, memory, losses, status, events, advisor, capture, type chips.
Initialize navigation, timeline pointer interactions, advisor/events/capture handlers, palette, help, theme, and global keyboard.
Read location.hash; if it names a known screen, activate it; otherwise activate overview.
Observe the native viewport width; re-render on width changes greater than 2px.
Cancel the playback animation frame on beforeunload.
outcomes: Overview at #overview or the hash-selected screen
failures: Missing fixture aborts the script; no fabricated data.

flows.title: Switch profiler screens
preconditions: screen name is one of overview, timeline, advisor, events, capture
steps: If leaving timeline while playing, stop playback.
Hide every screen section except the selected one; mark the matching rail tab aria-selected=true.
Update the topbar screen title and replace the URL hash without a history entry.
Scroll the stage to the top.
Lazily render timeline/events/advisor/capture when selected; timeline re-renders after layout if width changed.
outcomes: rail active state and title match

flows.title: Command palette
preconditions: no modal is already open when the shortcut fires
steps: Open the modal with an empty query and the first command active.
Filter commands by case-insensitive substring over label + group.
ArrowDown/ArrowUp move the active command within bounds; Enter runs it; click runs it.
Close the dialog, then run the command: immediate commands run directly, other commands run on the next task.
Close on Escape or backdrop; return focus to the palette button.
outcomes: or dialog closed with focus restored
failures: No matching command shows an empty state and Enter does nothing.

flows.title: Switch appearance palette
preconditions: theme id is one of dark, paper, latte, frappe, macchiato, mocha
steps: Open the appearance dialog and focus the active theme option.
Render core options (Graphite, Paper) and Catppuccin flavours (Latte, Frappe, Macchiato, Mocha) with four swatches each.
On option click, set the document data-theme immediately, update the button aria-label, re-render options, and toast the theme name.
Escape/backdrop/close closes and returns focus to the theme button; aria-expanded mirrors open state.
outcomes: Palette applied immediately across every token consumer

flows.title: Keyboard help sheet
steps: Open the modal and focus its close button.
Escape, close, or backdrop closes it.
Return focus to the help button.
outcomes: Help sheet open/closed with focus restored

flows.title: Open a journal file
preconditions: file is readable text; accepted extensions .ndjson/.jsonl/.json
steps: Read the file as text.
Parse one JSON object per non-empty line; count unreadable lines instead of failing the whole file.
Normalize event type/ts/cpu/comm/pid/duration/detail and fields; drop rows without a recognizable type.
If no events remain, show an error toast and keep the current session.
Sort events by timestamp; rebase timestamps to zero; assign stable row IDs.
Derive type counts, switch slices, threads, summary, and mode: intervals when switch durations exist, otherwise ticks.
Set the source chip to JOURNAL, reset timeline and event filters, render all screens, select Events, and toast the loaded counts plus skipped-line count.
failures: Read failure: Could not read that file
No recognizable events: No recognizable events in this journal
Some malformed lines: loaded toast includes N unreadable lines skipped

flows.title: Reload the healthy fixture
steps: Restore the embedded reference session.
Reset journal name/mode, timeline view/selection/playhead, event filters, source chip REPLAY.
Stop playback, render all, render inspector, and toast the fixture event count.

flows.title: Play and pause the playhead
preconditions: timeline screen becomes active if invoked elsewhere
steps: If playing, stop the animation and restore the Play label/icon.
If not playing, reset playhead to view start when it is at the end, set playing, swap label/icon to Pause.
Advance linearly across the visible span over 14000ms using requestAnimationFrame; loop at view end.
Update the clock every frame with three decimals.
Leaving the timeline stops playback; beforeunload cancels the loop.
failures: Space is ignored when focus is on a button, link, or tab so native activation is not hijacked.

flows.title: Zoom and fit the timeline
steps: Stop playback.
Zoom multiplies the span by 0.6 (in) or 1.7 (out), centered on the playhead unless a center is supplied; clamp span to 300ms..windowMs and keep the window inside 0..windowMs.
Fit resets the window to 0..windowMs and playhead to 0.
Double-click fits; minimap click centers the current span on the clicked ratio.
Clear the brush and re-render the timeline.
outcomes: New visible window and ruler step

flows.title: Brush a time range
preconditions: pointer x is inside the plot area, not on a button
steps: Start a drag at the pointer time.
After 4px horizontal movement, draw a 10%-opacity live brush between start and current time.
On release, if the range is greater than 20ms, zoom/focus to it; otherwise treat as a click.
outcomes: Window focused to brushed range with toast
failures: Releases with tiny movement fall back to click semantics.

flows.title: Select and inspect a slice or event
steps: Hit-test the row (CPU or thread) and time; return the slice/tick under the pointer.
Click slice: set selected slice, clear selected event, draw 1.5px text stroke, render inspector slice view.
Click tick: set selected event, draw 8px marker plus dashed guide, render inspector event view.
Escape or Clear clears both and returns inspector to idle.
Focus ±150ms zooms around the selected slice; Events for task opens the ledger filtered by comm.
Hover shows a tooltip with task, pid, cpu, time/duration.

flows.title: Filter advisor rules and jump to evidence
steps: Set one severity filter: All, WARNING, INFO, CLEAR, SKIP.
Re-render cards whose severity matches; show empty inline when none.
Show evidence runs focusRange() to the rule's time window and switches to the timeline with a toast.
If no rules are collected, show a single SKIP card and disable severity filters.
failures: Offline journal: rules are not re-evaluated; no evidence buttons.

flows.title: Filter the event ledger
preconditions: events screen is active or becomes active
steps: Focus the search input; `/` switches to Events first.
Match query as lowercase substring over type + comm + pid + detail.
Apply the selected event-type chip (or All).
Show the first 80 rows, count line, and more-results note when the match set is larger.
Show an empty state when no rows match; Escape clears the query, blurs, and re-renders.

flows.title: Inspect an event and move to the timeline
steps: Mark the row aria-selected=true and render detail: absolute timestamp, type badge, field table, privacy note.
Open in timeline: if the event is outside the current window, focus ±800ms around it; otherwise switch to timeline.
Select the matching slice when the journal is interval-based; otherwise select the event and show its tick marker.
Filter comm sets the event query to the task and clears the type filter.

flows.title: Copy capture commands
steps: Copy the exact command text with the Clipboard API; fall back to a hidden textarea + execCommand.
Show a success toast with the copied label; show an error toast if unavailable.

flows.title: Transient status feedback
steps: Set message text and error class, unhide, clear the existing timer, auto-hide after 3400ms.
outcomes: Error variant uses refuse left border

flows.title: Responsive relayout
steps: Apply the breakpoint rules in tokens.json/layout.breakpoints.
At 1024px the rail becomes a bottom bar and the keybar hides.
Native viewport resize re-renders the timeline when the plot width changes by more than 2px.
source: native resize callback in the surface loop

flows.title: Skip to profiler content
trigger: Tab from the native window until the skip link is focused
Enter on the focused skip link
steps: The skip link is visually hidden above the viewport at top -48px and becomes visible at top 10px when keyboard-focused.
Enter follows href=#main.
The main stage has tabindex=-1 and receives focus without opening or activating a window.
Normal screen-rail and screen controls remain keyboard reachable afterward.
outcomes: Focus moves to the profiler stage

flows.title: Choose a source and time frame
steps: Select source kind
Select time-frame preset
Dispatch source_select/source_window
outcomes: Source phase loading or SKIP/REFUSE with reason
failures: Unsupported surface fails closed with a stable reason

flows.title: Loading/ready/skip/refuse source states
steps: loading state
host completion
ready or explicit failure
outcomes: Analysis screens show the new source; failures keep the previous model intact
failures: Malformed journal shows an explicit reason, never zero-filled data

flows.title: First-run onboarding
trigger: first launch with incomplete onboarding version
steps: welcome
read-only contract
capabilities
choose source
failures: Skip persists the same version without claiming completion

flows.title: Start/stop/restart the read-only capture
preconditions: native Linux surface and READY live probe
steps: start
progress
stop or confirm restart
outcomes: Running state with events/lost/window; restart issues a new session label
failures: Non-Linux surfaces fail closed; externally owned recorder is attach-only

flows.title: Extract a recorder window
steps: request last-N window
host extract
derive console model
outcomes: WINDOW source shown; retention_loss explicit when older than retained

flows.title: Export artifacts
steps: queue export effect
host writes artifact
outcomes: journal/trace/report/incident written to the state directory
failures: Non-writable surfaces fail closed; failures surface as error toast + audit entry

flows.title: Audit provenance and action log
steps: render manifest provenance
render lifecycle markers
render action ring
outcomes: Read-only provenance and canonical action summary
failures: Missing manifest/retention renders SKIP/unavailable, never zeros

flows.title: Persist UI settings
steps: mutate settings
queue save_settings effect
host writes xsprof/ui-settings/v1
outcomes: Settings survive restart; corrupt file resets to defaults with a reason
failures: Unwritable surface applies session-only and reports the setting

flows.title: Accessibility tree and focus
steps: build platform-neutral nodes from Canvas hits
bridge to macOS NSAccessibility
outcomes: Every focusable control has a role and label; dialog focus trapped
failures: Linux AT-SPI reports an explicit SKIP reason
